description: GHS-OBAT global open building attributes is published by European Commission Joint Research Centre. It describes global building attributes linked to Overture footprint identifiers, including height, compactness, function, construction year and location, supplied as CSV and GeoPackage. Spatial scope is global. Spatial detail: Building attributes keyed to Overture footprints; GeoPackage geometry is the footprint centroid. Temporal coverage: 2020 attributes; Overture identifiers for release 2024-07-22.0. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links. The metadata lists CSV, GeoPackage; these files were not downloaded. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be read without payment; this does not establish free access to every linked artefact. Attributes are derived estimates; the record is distinct from the GHSL grid products and Overture geometry. This review identifies capacity planning, climate adaptation as potential simulation uses, subject to the stated limits. Related catalogue records are data-overture-maps-buildings, data-copernicus-ghsl-built-up-population. These are contextual links; no unverified interoperability or actual use is claimed.
